about: Live runs of the production app on Monad mainnet with a virtual passkey (scripts/live-mainnet.mjs), each on the site it names: the first two at https://letterlock-app.vercel.app, the rpId SDK 0.1.0 pinned, the third at https://app.letterlock.edycu.dev, the rpId 0.1.1 pins. Each run spends one drip.

runs.diagnosis: The drip landed; the publish that followed was never included. Driving the same page with a virtual passkey and a faked eth_getBalance (nothing spent) showed viem preparing the publish with eth_fillTransaction: Monad mainnet filled maxFeePerGas 152 gwei and viem multiplied it by 1.2, so the signed publish capped its fee at 182.4 gwei, and rpc.monad.xyz answered eth_sendRawTransaction with 'Signer had insufficient balance': a sender must hold gas limit x fee cap = 70,863 x 182.4 gwei = 0.0129254112 MON, and the drip (1.5 x 70,863 x 102 gwei) sent 0.010842039. Monad testnet's RPC does not check this, so the testnet end-to-end run passed. Fix: the drip covers the publish at the wallet's bid plus 10% (0.01421795232 MON at a 100 gwei base fee). The virtual passkey of this run is gone, so its account 0xceff4e8c0d9b090b36449865320a7387f7f0332f keeps the 0.010842039 MON and can never publish or spend it.

Create, drip and publish passed on mainnet under the new rpId: a Chromium WebAuthn virtual authenticator with PRF made the passkey, the drip paid its account and the account published its own key (steps). The register step then timed out: the script typed the address and pressed Look up before React had hydrated the page, so the form submitted natively and reloaded as /register?q=…, which the page does not read, and 'Found by keyOf' never showed. The page itself listed the key, first of 5, read to block 108,571,434. The browser closed on the failure and the virtual passkey with it, so nothing sealed to this key can be opened: lib/known-keys.json labels it, and the script now waits for hydration before any click. No second create was run; the judge's step 2 for this address, the reference agent writing to it from /judge, is e2e-results/judge-agent-live.json.
